summary: Design role-based AI learning journeys, measure skills uplift, and plan workforce communications. Explore the AI literacy training course.
lede: Enterprise AI literacy training helps workforce learning leaders connect AI adoption to the tasks, capabilities and oversight needs of different roles. It is for CHROs, L&D leaders, transformation officers and workforce planners who need to map role-based learning journeys, set responsible-use expectations and measure skills uplift through baseline and follow-up evidence.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who set workforce learning priorities, connect AI adoption to job capabilities, or need credible evidence of skills development across functions.
outcomes: AI Role Redesign and Task Analysis
modules: AI Literacy Strategy with OECD Principles
prerequisites: Experience in HR, learning and development, workforce planning, organizational change, or digital transformation is recommended. No coding or programming is required; you should be ready to work with role and learning examples from your organization.
